study_identification.title: Comprehensive volumetric phenotyping of the neonatal brain in Down syndrome

study_characteristics.study_objective: Construct normative models of neonatal brain tissue volumes using a large dHCP control cohort and quantify individual- and group-level volumetric deviations in neonates with Down syndrome, including subgroup analyses by congenital heart disease.

dataset_name.supporting_text: We used a robust cross-sectional sample of 493 preterm to term-born control neonates from the developing Human Connectome Project (dHCP) to perform normative modeling...

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Group comparisons with Mann–Whitney U and Kruskal–Wallis tests; effect sizes via Cliff's delta; linear regressions versus PMA and WBV (covariation); median/quartile regressions (quantreg); extra sum-of-squares F-tests for slope/intercept differences; BH FDR correction.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Neonates with Down syndrome show reduced whole brain, cerebral white matter, and cerebellar volumes; relatively enlarged temporal and parietal lobes and deep gray matter (lentiform nuclei, thalami); and enlarged lateral ventricles. Age-related volumetric differences observed between CHD+ and CHD- within DS for select regions.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Relative total cortical GM enlarged while total WM reduced; regional pattern of relatively enlarged temporal and parietal lobes with reduced frontal, cingulate, insular, and occipital lobes; lentiform nuclei and thalami proportionally enlarged, caudate not; cerebellum disproportionately small; brainstem relatively enlarged (but not after WBV adjustment); lateral ventricles disproportionately enlarged; eCSF enlarged in preterm DS neonates with age-related decrease.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Single-site acquisition and scanner; relatively small DS sample (n=25); no reported normative model performance metrics or external validation; neonatal age window only (32–46 weeks PMA); need for longitudinal, multi-site cohorts for developmental trajectories and clinical translation.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Normative modeling enables individualized volumetric deviation profiling in neonatal DS. While not immediately clinical, it may inform early phenotypic severity stratification and guide future early interventions pending validation.

general_notes.general_notes: Segmentation definitions: lateral ventricles include cavum septum pellucidum; eCSF includes 3rd and 4th ventricles but excludes lateral ventricles. Relative volumes computed as proportion of TTV (ventricles to TBV; eCSF to ICV). Single-site Philips Achieva 3T (Evelina). dHCP release 2021 used for controls.
